snippet.title: Dreadzone - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
Scavenge for resources, craft tools, build a shelter and try to survive in the DREADZONE, a new first-person survival game from Eshed set in a deadly quarantine zone. A new trailer was featured in the FGS Live From gamescom latam showcase revealing new content. Harvest trees and natural resources to fortify your base, laying traps such as wire and mines to stop rampaging mutants and survivors. Coming to PC on June 26.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
